title: Classic Switcher
description: the space switcher rail — the far-left column of space marks. Ships the shipped implementation (SWITCHER_RAIL) from @fraym/ui rather than a reduced lookalike, so a fully marketplace-assembled space is byte-identical to the built-in one. The switcher is app chrome (the shell mounts one regardless), but its FILL is a normal registered contract, so it is packable like the rest.
